notes: Removes the wrapper's fixed automatic 120-FPS ceiling. Without --fps, interpolation now targets the display refresh reported by mpv, including fractional refresh rates and rates above 240 Hz. Adds rate-selection regressions and a headless extracted-package mpv test with simulated 240-Hz refresh. The native engine and interpolation-quality settings are unchanged. Actual sustainable throughput depends on the hardware and workload. ARM64 plugins are built and tested in CI, ad-hoc signed and not notarized. mpv, Python and VapourSynth remain separate dependencies.
